# Standards Index

Curated, verified index of standards applicable to the Eviden KMS. Every URL is a
canonical, stable publication link (final/versioned). Organized by issuing body.

> **Maintenance**: when adding a standard, verify the URL resolves to the actual
> publication page (not a search result). Include the year and revision in the entry.

---

## Academic Papers (via cryptobib)

| Resource | Location | Coverage |
|----------|----------|----------|
| crypto.bib | `documentation/pandoc/cryptobib/crypto.bib` | Main bibliography database |
| abbrev3.bib | `documentation/pandoc/cryptobib/abbrev3.bib` | Full conference/journal abbreviations |
| Coverage | — | CRYPTO, EUROCRYPT, ASIACRYPT, ACM CCS, PKC, TCC, ESORICS (1981–2021) |

> **Usage rule**: grep `crypto.bib` for the exact bib key before citing any paper.
> Never cite a paper that was not found in the bibliography during this session.
